subruns._likely_cause: the preflight runs `--device cpu` under /opt/train's CUDA-built torch. `nproc` reports the HOST's CPUs, not the cgroup grant, so torch sizes its thread pool far above the container's quota and thrashes. This repository has recorded that container CPU count lies; the packing preflight does strictly more CPU work than the batching one (a four-protocol screen plus two full toy scorers) and crossed the threshold where it matters. NOT CONFIRMED -- no diagnosis was run on the pod, because diagnosing it there costs $1.09/h.
subruns._second_defect: the preflight was UNBOUNDED. Every other long step in this launcher has a timeout; this one could consume the session, and did. It also redirects to its own file, so its progress was invisible in the launch log -- 23 minutes looked identical to 16 seconds until the clock was read.
